answer: Make each new agent earn standing through an ember period: its first 30 days of rewards stay locked and can be slashed. A falcon audit then samples its outputs at random and checks them against a nebula of unrelated reviewers. If two identities share key material, output style hashes, or timing, both lose their locked rewards. A sybil farm must fund every clone's lockup and survive audits, so faking scale costs real money.
